correctness.rationale: Every uniform matching on ordered ranks is equally likely under n independent continuous endpoint pairs. Conditional crossing and nesting means f_C=2ℓ(1−ℓ) and f_N=ℓ²+2u(1−v) give centered first projections with exactly diagonal covariance I_2/45 by integration against density 2 on 0<u<v<1. Exact canonical Hoeffding kernel variance is 8/45 and cross covariance −1/9, giving Var(C)=Var(N)=n(n−1)(n+3)/45, Cov(C,N)=−n(n−1)/18 and the displayed full covariance using C+N+A=binom(n,2). Degenerate variance O(n²) is negligible at n^(3/2) scale; bounded iid vector CLT yields independent N(0,1/45) coordinates. A newly executed checker verified 146,683 exact assertions and symbolic identities. The unrestricted limit rests on the analytic proof, not finite enumeration.

value.rationale: Crossing, nesting and alignment counts partition all pairs of chords, so joint dependence is a natural structural question. Both crossing and nesting have order-n³ variance, yet their order-n² negative finite covariance vanishes upon normalization; orthogonality of the leading projections explains a nonobvious independent bivariate Gaussian limit. The complete three-coordinate fluctuation law follows from the conservation identity and gives interpretable covariance geometry. This is more than a routine renaming or isolated finite table calculation.
